name: Marshal Haggard
summary: At Eastvale, Marshal Haggard keeps the arms he gathered over a lifetime of service. Harry Burlguard sends novice warriors from Stormwind City to meet the retired marshal and seek better weapons.

sections.title: A Veteran's Armory
sections.body: Stormwind's novice warriors need more than skill to face danger beyond the city. Harry Burlguard sends promising fighters east through Elwynn Forest to meet Marshal Haggard, a retired officer who served the realm for years. Over a lifetime in the field, Haggard gathered a personal armory. His home near the Eastvale Logging Camp holds weapons for young warriors seeking better arms.

sections.title: Retirement at Eastvale
sections.body: Marshal Haggard lives in a secluded manor near the Eastvale Logging Camp. Years of service have weakened his sight, and he sometimes mistakes approaching travelers for prowling riverpaw gnolls. Age keeps him in this quiet corner of eastern Elwynn. Even so, Stormwind's guards and trainers still respect the old marshal.

aliases: where do i get marshal haggard quest
faq.answer: Harry Burlguard, a warrior trainer in Stormwind City, sends promising young warriors to Marshal Haggard.
Marshal Haggard lives in a manor just east of the Eastvale Logging Camp, in far eastern Elwynn Forest near the Redridge Mountains border.

faq.q: Why does Harry Burlguard send you to Haggard?
faq.answer: Harry Burlguard sends you to Marshal Haggard because young warriors need better arms than their training blades. Haggard gathered weapons and armor during his long career and may share them with those who prove their worth.

faq.q: Why does Haggard mistake visitors for gnolls?
faq.answer: Marshal Haggard's eyesight has worsened with age. Gnolls harass Elwynn Forest's eastern timber operations and outskirts, leaving the old veteran wary of sudden visitors.

faq.q: What comes after completing this quest?
faq.answer: After you greet Marshal Haggard, he tests your mettle by sending you to deal with Dead-tooth Jack before he considers sharing weapons from his stores.

faq.q: Is this quest available to classes other than warriors?
faq.answer: No. This path is for warriors, as part of their training around level ten and their preparation for dangers beyond Elwynn Forest.

angles.text: As an Alliance warrior, you leave Stormwind's formal training and venture into the wilderness in search of arms.
As an Alliance fighter, you follow Stormwind's reliance on retired veterans and their private stores to prepare the next generation of defenders.
